items.passage: Next week is the summer holiday. Jenny has many plans. On Monday, she is going to visit her grandparents in the countryside. On Wednesday, she will go swimming with her friends. She is also going to read three books and learn to cook. On Saturday, her family will have a big birthday party for her brother. Jenny can't wait.

items.advPassage: Mark is going to enter junior high school next year. He is a little nervous but also excited. He plans to join the basketball team and make new friends. His parents are going to buy him a new bike so he can ride to school. Mark hopes he will study hard and get good grades. He believes next year will be a great year.
